extension_definitions.hostname: ASCII IDNA hostname from frozen inspector; IP hosts get five zeros. Dot-separated nonempty labels. Only a leading www label in the PSL subdomain is removed for depth. Ratios use full ASCII hostname length including dots; ASCII digits only.
extension_definitions.path_query: Original path/query, no percent decoding or Unicode normalization. Segments: nonempty slash-separated path parts. Fields: nonempty ampersand-separated query parts, including flags and repeated keys. Semicolon is not a separator. Encoded ratio = 3 * count of valid %HH triplets / original component length; empty component gives zero.

feature_schema.input: Original input_url, not normalized_url; outer ASCII spaces removed by the inspector.
feature_schema.length_unit: Python Unicode code points; encoded percent sequences are not decoded.

limitations: Feature choice and hypotheses were informed by previously observed validation.
Thresholds are selected and measured on the same validation; empirical caps are not population guarantees.
Historical labels, one seed, no confidence interval or causal algorithm-superiority claim.
This is one fixed configuration per model, not an exhaustive comparison or deployment acceptance.
CPU deterministic mode does not guarantee identical scores across OS/compiler versions.
No external API inference, Big Data training claim or calibrated confidence.

protocol.feature_choice_basis: G1.9 observed external validation; exploratory and not independent
protocol.primary_endpoint: difference in minimum recall across the two sources at each models own joint-source 1% empirical FPR cap
protocol.validation_roles: PhiUSIIL validation and previously observed external reused-validation
protocol.weighting: same G1.6 four source-class cells, each total N/4; no additional class weighting
